## Summary and what was read

An exploratory, AI-drafted design (Ren aligned with the direction; nothing built or measured): community software grown through recursive local contracts, durable modules, scoped adoption and, later, self-improving decomposition. The account names it once, among applications: design programmes, not results, correspondence not established. Where an entry is carried in part, a general sentence of the account states that part on its own model, and none states it of community software. Eleven so agree with a checked law's form, among them: joint plans compose given projection and compatibility, which two local proofs linked do not supply; two locally fine plans fail jointly on one shared reserve; readiness counts independent causes, not names; a budget covering correction alone does not pay for migration; a program can fit every old record yet answer a novel expression wrongly. Other links are joins proposed here, and say so. The account has no law of change effort under growth or of savings from a representation. Divergences kept: authority as given, surpassing as goal, whose losses a ledger reads, continuity without premises, everyone happily growing it. No contrary reading found; looked.
